What is Ibernia in one sentence?: What is Ibernia in one sentence?
Ibernia ia a goal-based financial planni: Ibernia ia a goal-based financial planning app for advisors that models cashflows, savings pots, and what-ifs, then generates draft advice with firm specific rules
Use this section to add your client’s ke: Use this section to add your client’s key life events and financial goals. These events shape the cashflow forecast and can be linked to specific transactions such as incomes or expenses. Add new events to the timeline or move existing ones to adjust their timing.
Enter all savings pots, pensions, and in: Enter all savings pots, pensions, and investment accounts held by your client in this section (excluding property). In the event of an income shortfall, these pots will be drawn down in the sequence displayed below. You may rearrange the order by dragging and dropping the pots, or by using the up/down arrows.
These are the default assumptions used t: These are the default assumptions used to save time when creating a new plan. You can change them anytime for each client.
The assumed rate inflation is expected t: The assumed rate inflation is expected to rise by, per year. This assumption affects the entire cashflow model, as future values are inflation adjusted into real terms.
How satisfied are you with your current: How satisfied are you with your current financial planning?
Input all regular and one-off income sou: Input all regular and one-off income sources and expenses relevant to your client. These entries will feed directly into the cashflow model, influencing the projected financial outcomes. You may link transactions to specific events, and adjust timing or frequency as needed.
Add all expected contributions to and wi: Add all expected contributions to and withdrawals from your client’s savings pots throughout the forecast period. Contributions will transfer funds from the client’s Current account to a selected Savings Pot. Withdrawals will move funds from a Savings Pot back to the Current account to cover shortfalls.

ADD_EVENT.SELECT_EVENT_TYPE_TOOLTIP: Select the type of life event or goal you want to create (for example, 'Home', 'New car' or 'Education').
ADD_EVENT.EVENT_TYPE_TOOLTIP: Choose whether this event represents an Income (money coming in) or an Expense (money going out).
ADD_EVENT.ENTER_AMOUNT_TOOLTIP: Enter the amount linked to this event. Use the dropdown to define how often it occurs (e.g., every month, every year, or one-off).
ADD_EVENT.DEFINE_EVENT_PERIOD_TOOLTIP: Define when this event starts and, if applicable, when it ends. Ibernia will include this period in the client’s cashflow projection.
ADD_EVENT.AMOUNT_GROWTH_TOOLTIP: Defines how this amount will evolve over time. You can choose to: Keep it fixed (the amount stays the same each year), Match inflation (it increases automatically based on the default inflation rate set in Preferences), or Apply a custom rate (you decide the exact yearly percentage change). This setting helps make projections more realistic by accounting for rising costs or expected income growth.
